name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: WorkTrace (a persistent file tree and timeline of Claude's file activity) and DecisionCritic (a separate critic model that reviews Claude's decisions).

plugins.name: worktrace
plugins.description: A persistent file tree and timeline of the files Claude reads, searches and changes, with summaries and exact diffs.

plugins.name: decisioncritic
plugins.description: Reviews Claude's observable decisions with a separate critic model and shows evidence-backed criticism cards you can accept, challenge, implement and verify.
